values: For every fixed complex von Neumann algebra M, prove that some epsilon_M>0 forces every complex von Neumann algebra N with ordinary complex d_BM(M,N)<1+epsilon_M to be Jordan *-isomorphic to M; establish the same conclusion for d_BM(M_*,N_*) with the same threshold, including nonseparable algebras and preduals.

Ordinary Banach–Mazur rigidity of von Neumann algebras — Alec Kriebel (ORCID 0009-0001-9320-500X). Preprint/publication date 2026-10-07; production Zenodo publication and DOI resolution verified. Attributed consequence of OpenAI family295 ordinary bounded self-coefficient Hochschild vanishing and Roydor’s geometric/deformation machinery. Explicit proof extension beyond Roydor’s published separable-predual theorem uses two fixed source algebras and full-carrier reconstruction of finite odd type-I summands. The threshold depends on M; N must be a von Neumann algebra; the conclusion is Jordan *-isomorphism, with the same threshold for canonical preduals. Fresh October7 priority audit is bounded and does not certify firstness. Three distinct complete-package AI adversarial reviews passed; clean reproduction and finite mechanism checks passed. Extensive AI use; no conventional human refereeing or reproduced Lean kernel build. CC BY4.0 for original material; unchanged upstream material retains Apache2.0. Record: https://zenodo.org/records/23217863. Sources, audits and reproduction: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/tree/main/openai_followon_banach_mazur_von_neumann
